description:
Timetable, substitutions and news for ZSE Bydgoszcz - no login, works offline. Unofficial app for students of the Zespół Szkół Elektronicznych (school of electronics) in Bydgoszcz, Poland. It reads the school's public websites directly - no login and no personal data collected. Works offline. Features
  • Daily and weekly timetable with substitutions applied; the current lesson shows the time left
  • Class groups: only the lessons you attend (languages, workshops, PE, religion), including several groups of one subject
  • Substitutions for your class and group, including cancelled lessons, plus notices the school adds under a date (e.g. blood donation)
  • Notifications about new substitutions (day, lesson, subject and teacher), news and school notices, quiet hours
  • Days off: no reminders or live notification on holidays, breaks and winter break
  • Live notification on school days: countdown to the break or the next lesson, what is on now and next, when lessons end (optional)
  • Notes for upcoming lessons with a reminder the day before or before the lesson
  • Lesson reminders with the room number
  • School news read in the app, with photos, search and favourites available offline
  • Home screen with the current or next lesson, breaks, substitutions and time left until lessons end
  • Widgets: Next lesson, Day plan, Substitutions, plus a quick settings tile
  • Commute: in the morning buses and trams to your next lesson (time to spare, last one that makes it), after lessons the way home (when to leave), live delays, without GPS (optional)
  • Custom subject names and colours, light and dark theme, accent colour, ready-made or custom background colour, wallpaper colours, app icon choice
The app's interface is in Polish. Not affiliated with the school or VULCAN. Inspired by Atom (iOS) by Kacper Górka. Free software under GNU GPL v3 or later.
